summary: Prudential plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a PDMR shareholding notification under the UK Market Abuse Regulation, mapped to its US equivalent as an insider transaction disclosure. Chair Douglas Flint acquired 11,000 ordinary shares of 5 pence each at GBP 9.22 per share on 2026-11-06 on the London Stock Exchange, an aggregate consideration of roughly GBP 101,420. No board recommendation, advisor, stake change, premium, or regulatory clock is involved. This is an ordinary open-market purchase by a director, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
